title: Are Argentina being treated favourably at World Cup?
facts: The Egyptian Football Association requested that FIFA remove match officials from the tournament following their round-of-16 defeat to Argentina.
Egypt national team coach Hossam Hassan publicly alleged that match refereeing exhibited bias in favor of Argentina.
Argentina defeated Switzerland 3-1 after extra time in the 2026 World Cup quarter-finals.
Portuguese referee Joao Pedro da Silva Pinheiro sent off Switzerland forward Breel Embolo after a VAR review.
Argentina defeated England 2-1 in the semi-finals of the World Cup tournament.
Argentina midfielder Enzo Fernandez avoided a booking following an unpenalized challenge on England's Elliot Anderson.
Egypt led Argentina 2-0 before conceding late goals and losing 3-2 in their knockout match.
A goal by Egypt's Mostafa Zico was disallowed following a VAR review for a foul by Marwan Attia on Lisandro Martinez.
The entire on-field officiating team and lead VAR appointed for the France versus Morocco quarter-final were from Argentina.
Facundo Tello served as the referee for the quarter-final match between France and Morocco.
Lionel Messi was not cautioned following a challenge on Algeria captain Aissa Mandi during the group stage.
United States player Folarin Balogun received a red card following a VAR review against Bosnia-Herzegovina for a similar tackle.
Inter Miami was chosen to represent the host nation in the inaugural expanded Club World Cup despite LA Galaxy winning the MLS Cup.
FIFA adjusted the World Cup draw in December to place the top four ranked nations into separate bracket quarters.
Argentina was awarded five penalties during the 2022 World Cup, setting a tournament record.
